[LSER.16.4.1] `pXX` for any integer percentile in `1..99`
inclusive, returning `Float?` — `null` exactly when the read is
cold ([LSER.19.8]). `p0` and `p100` are not legal; authors use `min`
and `max` for the extremes. Sub-percent quantiles (`p99.9`,
`p99.99`) are deferred; the grammar reserves the syntactic
space.
